capability_assessment.finding: I cannot responsibly certify continuous detection of every variant in this witness with my current Tibetan image-reading performance.
capability_assessment.evidence: At the opening verb (PDF2 row2 / U12), a large, readable-looking stack cannot be discriminated confidently as bstan/bstun or another reading. The repeated formula at U30 is likewise unresolved. As sequential comparison progressed, uncertain suffix/prefix/stack decisions recurred at U148, U167, U193, U207, U234, U260, U262, U295, U304, U315, U316. Some could be actual differences from A; their unknown state prevents all-variant clearance.
capability_assessment.source_quality: Most inspected Tsamdrak images are sharp enough for a competent manuscript reader. This is primarily a limit of this reviewer, not a claim that all listed passages are objectively unreadable or that better scanning will necessarily solve them.
capability_assessment.risk: Expected-text-assisted recognition can hide small orthographic differences. Apparent agreement in the rest of a row must not be converted into an agreement certificate.
capability_assessment.reason_for_stopping_expansion: Further page-by-page recognition with recurring unresolved distinctions would enlarge claimed coverage faster than dependable all-variant evidence. The stop is a demonstrated reliability limit, not an arbitrary sample quota.
capability_assessment.needed_next_step: A qualified Tibetan manuscript reader or independently verified diplomatic transcript should read the source continuously; narrow second readings should first resolve the listed discriminating glyphs. Keep secure local observations and candidates separate.
capability_assessment.bounds: No full-chapter, whole-witness, main-text-completeness or annotation-completeness certification. No assertion that all actual conflicts were detected even within the attempted rows.

integration_note: This review snapshot may quote the earlier flattened A transcript as its comparison context. The current reading text and linked Adzom scan interventions govern; a source note removed from A main text is not a missing main verse in the other witness.
